messages:
lina-support: Heads-up: a customer (acct: acme-corp) hit repeated tool.call failures after today's CI deploy. They see 422 schema validation errors in production.

sam-ml: Can you paste the exact error? 422 usually means payload mismatch.

lina-support: Copy from logs:

```
ERROR tool_runner: schema validation failed: missing required property 'callback_url' at /tools/submit_job/args
Request payload: {"tool":"submit_job","args":{"job_id":"1234","params":null}}
```

qa-jen: Our CI golden tests started failing for toolcall-schema-suite in the last run (build #7456). Failing case: submit_job with nested params object gets coerced to null in the runner step.

kevin-eng: That matches a change I landed in runtime: optional arg coercion for JSON args to compress empty objects. I might have introduced a regression where {} -> null when quantized.

infra-bot: deploy:prod completed 2026-03-17T10:05:12Z by kevin-eng

lina-support: Customer repro curl (they said this used to work):

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/toolcall \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-tool-3","input":"run job","tool":"submit_job","args":{"job_id":"1234","params":{"priority":"high"},"callback_url":"https://acme/cb"}}'
```

sam-ml: In CI the golden prompt harness asserts the tool args shape via this schema snippet:

```
"submit_job": {
  "type":"object",
  "required": ["job_id","params","callback_url"]
}
```

qa-jen: CI error output:

```
AssertionError: expected params to be object, got null
Full payload at /tools/submit_job/args: {"job_id":"1234","params":null}
```

kevin-eng: Confirmed — my recent change added a compacting pass that collapses empty maps. Bug: compacting logic treats any node with only string keys as 'empty' after quantization and turns it to null. Fix incoming.

support-ops: Customer is blocking production. Can we hotfix or rollback? They reported 50% of tool calls failing with 422 and latency spikes while we retry.

kevin-eng: I will push a quick rollback to revert the compacting pass. Also adding a regression test: CI golden suite should include a submit_job with nested params and ensure params !== null after serialization.

sam-ml: Also add an eval case for tool choice: ensure model chooses correct tool when args include callback_url (this was flaky in staging with our function-caller scoring). Put it in toolcall-evals/golden-tool-choices.

qa-jen: I'll pin a temporary CI job that re-runs the schema suite against the production binary and will post results here.

infra-bot: rollback:prod initiated 2026-03-17T10:21:01Z by kevin-eng

lina-support: Customer updated: errors dropped after rollback, they can proceed. Thanks team. Please follow up with a patch + CI test to prevent reintroducing.

kevin-eng: Patch submitted, PR: https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/pull/2814 — includes fix + new unit + golden CI entry.

qa-jen: CI run for PR passes locally, pushing to CI now. Will notify if flakey.

support-ops: Marking this escalated -> resolved for now. Please add postmortem snippet to incidents channel with timeline and test ids.

lina-support: Adding repro and customer timeline to ticket #4521. Thanks all :pray:
